caption:
Ronaldo retired. Portugal lost 4-1 at home.

Portugal's first game since Cristiano Ronaldo quit international football ended Portugal 1, Denmark 4 in Braga on Saturday.

Before kick-off every player and mascot wore a Ronaldo 7 shirt. The fans held up a "thank you, captain" banner. Then Denmark took over: Hojbjerg scored a penalty after a Ruben Dias handball, Rasmus Hojlund scored twice and Joachim Andersen headed in a fourth. Bernardo Silva's goal came in the 93rd minute.

Ronaldo leaves with 146 goals in 234 games, both men's international records.

Portugal are already in the Nations League quarter-finals. Avoid defeat against Wales in Cardiff on Tuesday and they win the group.
